title: Pioneer Treasure Hunt
subtitle: A riddle trail from Camp Liberty in Skyline Valley

sections.title: How to Start the Hunt
sections.html:
There's no quest to start: the hunt begins with a note at Camp Liberty. Fast travel there and clear out the enemies first.

{img:camp-liberty-map}

sections.title: Pioneer Treasure Hunt Walkthrough
sections.html:
Step 1 – Read the Pioneer Treasure Hunt Start note

From the fast travel point, face east and run through the gates to the Welcome to Summer Camp totem pole. Turn south and walk until the Tadpole and Possum vending machines are on your left: the note is pinned to the poster board on the other side of them.

{img:start-note-location}{note:Storm_TreasureHunt_Camp_Start}

Step 2 – Solve the riddles

Each verse of the riddle points to the next place. Nothing in the game checks that you visit the first ones: the riddle is just the route to the prize. If you want to solve it yourself, stop here. The answers are in Riddle Answers below, which stays closed until you open it.

sections.title: Riddle Answers
sections.html:
Step 3 – Riddle 1: Stony Man Lookout

Beyond vast falling waters and a lofty tower up high, lies a stream near a bog, which catches ones eye. The first verse is Stony Man Lookout. Fast travel or run there.

{img:riddle-1-stony-man-lookout}

Step 4 – Riddle 2: Shining Creek Cavern

Follow me down, past swampy trails I endorse, to the source's route, where liquid tales course. The second verse is Shining Creek Cavern.

{img:riddle-2-shining-creek-cavern}

Step 5 – Riddle 3: climb the rocks at the end of the river

Climb over my mouth, and let your eyes see, three large rocks and an old husk of a tree. From Shining Creek Cavern, face north and follow the river to where it ends, then climb to the top of the rocks.

{img:riddle-3-rocks-end-of-river}

Step 6 – Find the Pioneer Scout logo

Line yourself up between the Johnson's Acre and north map markers and walk slowly forward. Watch for the Pioneer Scout logo painted on a rock to your right.

{img:riddle-3-pioneer-scout-logo}

Step 7 – Riddle 4: loot the Hollow Stump

Explore within, where secrets disguise, to uncover the truth and your well deserved prize. The Hollow Stump is next to the logo. Critters attack as you get close, so be ready, and there's no fast travel point nearby, so it's a bit of a run back.

{img:riddle-4-hollow-stump}{note:Storm_TreasureHunt_Camp_End}

sections.title: Rewards
sections.html:
The Hollow Stump holds {loot:Storm_PionnerTresureHunt}, plus the Pioneer Treasure Hunt End note.

{img:hollow-stump-loot}

sections.title: FAQ and Important Info
sections.html:
Do I have to visit every riddle location?

No. Nothing in the game tracks it, and the prize stump is always there. The riddle is just the way to find it.

Is this a quest?

No. There's no quest and nothing in your Pip-Boy tracks it. It's a hidden hunt left by the Pioneer Scout leaders.

Where can I see the Totem Pole Ornament?

There's a picture in the Gallery at the bottom of this page.
